outcome: Pre- and postductal oxygen saturation (SpO2) values
False-positive rate of pulse oximetry screening
finding: This study found that while SpO2 values differ between neonates screened before and after 24 hours of age, pulse oximetry screening effectively identifies infants with other significant pathologies in addition to CCHD.
mod_finding: This study on pulse oximetry screening noted mode of delivery as a factor in their study but did not examine its association with any outcomes.
